reviews.specification: Implement inventory-inspection@1 with one round of individual learning. Public input: {mode:'page'|'item',page?:integer>=0,pageSize?:integer[1,16],itemId?:string}; defaults mode='page', page=0, pageSize=8. Shared references: actorId is bound to the authenticated living caller; itemId resolves an exact existing item, never a resource alias. Read only actual carried inventory owned by that actor, excluding ground items and other actors' holdings. Dependencies: authoritative inventory/ownership state, existing observable-property filtering, action scheduling and personal-result rendering; no material or tool prerequisites. Execution costs one round and 0.2 energy, with normal metabolism; insufficient energy fails without a debit. At execution completion, atomically validate and read current state, sorting by stable item ID. Return {inventoryRevision,page,pageSize,totalItems,totalPages,hasPrevious,hasNext,items}; each item includes exact id, resource, quantity, represented quantityTenths when present, and already observable processing form and availability/reservation status. Item mode returns only the matching carried item or a non-disclosing unavailable result. Never expose concealed composition or infer tool suitability, intactness or usable surface area beyond represented observable state. Revision changes between page requests are explicitly flagged so callers can restart; do not fabricate stable historical holdings. No inputs are escrowed, transferred, consumed, combined or locked. This is a single-round operation with no partial output or remaining work after completion; interruption or death before completion cancels the pending read without modifying inventory or emitting a successful result. No continuing effects, maintenance, new objects, collision changes or spatial reach requirement: this is inspection of one's own carried possessions. Declare inventory-inspected for completed results and inventory-inspection-stopped for cancellation, carrying actor/interface, request parameters, revision and success status; personal result payloads remain private. Bind the complete bounded page or item result to the action result, personal inspection panel and replay, with explicit pagination controls and omission counts; do not pass it through the truncating default inventory summary. Replays display the recorded execution-time result rather than querying later state. Migration adds the interface and presentation adapter without rewriting item IDs, provenance, ownership, quantities or prior records. Reuse inventory access and rendering code where available, separately from registering this new function. Implementation and review consume no simulation time and confer no mastery.
